title: Ox Passion Spearmint Nic Salts E-Liquid 10ml
description: OX Passion Spearmint is the perfect choice for vapers seeking a palate-cleansing and straightforward profile. It focuses entirely on the crisp, garden-fresh taste of Spearmint leaves. The inhale provides a gentle, botanical sweetness, which is quickly followed by a breezy and refreshing exhale that leaves the senses invigorated without the harshness of a heavy ice menthol. Formulated with a 50% VG / 50% PG ratio, this Nicotine Salt e-liquid provides excellent versatility for Mouth-to-Lung (MTL) devices. It pairs flawlessly with coils ranging from 1.2ohm to 0.8ohm, ensuring crisp flavour delivery and discreet vapour production alongside a silky throat hit. Developed by OXVA, a highly respected name in vaping hardware, the OX Passion Salts range offers a premium selection of e-liquids. These specialised blends are crafted to operate flawlessly with modern refillable vape devices, delivering a highly consistent vape. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths.
